title: Quaint Dense Japanese Rice Onigiri
description: A low-carb friendly, dense Japanese dish from Kyushu, featuring red pepper flakes and candy, formed into onigiri and stored in a mason jar.

ingredients.name: candy
ingredients.notes: preferably small, hard candies like M&M's or Skittles

instructions: Rinse the Japanese short grain rice thoroughly and cook it according to the package instructions with 2 1/4 cups of water.
In a small saucepan, combine the rice vinegar, sesame oil, salt, and red pepper flakes, and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the vinegar mixture for 5 minutes, then let it cool to room temperature.
Once the rice is cooked, allow it to cool to room temperature, then mix in the cooled vinegar mixture and the crushed candy.
Wet your hands with water and shape the rice mixture into small triangular onigiri shapes.
If using norii seaweed sheets, wrap each onigiri with a sheet.
Place the onigiri in a mason jar and store it in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Serve the onigiri chilled, garnished with additional red pepper flakes if desired.
